title: A valley floor that is sinking
text: In the Antelope Valley, long-term pumping of groundwater has lowered the water table. That has made wells harder to pump, cut their efficiency, and caused the land surface to sink.

s1.title: Antelope Valley
s1.quote: Long-term groundwater pumping has lowered the water table, thereby increasing pumping lifts, reducing well efficiency, and causing land subsidence.
